summary: Unified Step-Up authentication (email OTP + auto-retry via axios interceptor) end-to-end verified on backend and frontend. Backend gate + rate limit + verify + revoke + scope isolation: 10/10 pytest cases PASSED. Frontend flows 1-9 all functionally PASSED against SAFE-MODE prod DB (no mutations performed). Wallet delete cancel, wrong-code error UI, Manage-wallets full verify with preview_otp then Lock-now, cancel-closes-manager, referrals payout card (credit mode, no legacy OTP testids), 2FA card renders disabled, delete-brand modal (typing-confirm, no OTP), no legacy console errors. Two data-testid gaps found in StepUpDialog (stepup-error and stepup-verify-btn are missing from DOM even though the error message and Verify button are rendered visually with role=alert and accessible name 'Verify').

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid=stepup-error on the inline error element. The message 'Invalid code. Please try again.' IS rendered and reachable via role=alert, but the testid contract in /app/Components/UI/StepUp/StepUpDialog.tsx docs is not honoured. `[data-testid^=stepup]` in DOM returned only ['stepup-dialog','stepup-title','stepup-body','stepup-code-panel','stepup-contact-hint','stepup-cancel-btn'].
Missing data-testid=stepup-verify-btn on the primary 'Verify' button inside the code panel. Button is visible/enabled; automation had to fall back to role=button name=/Verify/.

action_items:
Add data-testid='stepup-error' to the OtpInputPanel error

in /app/Components/UI/StepUp/StepUpDialog.tsx (or the OtpInputPanel subcomponent) so E2E tests can assert the invalid-code path without falling back to role=alert.
Add data-testid='stepup-verify-btn' to the primary Verify button in the code panel.

Optional: also expose stepup-method-tabs / stepup-method-email etc. testids that are enumerated in the module docs but not present in DOM (only 6 stepup-* testids seen). Not blocking, since this account only supports the email method.
critical_code_review_comments: StepUpDialog testid contract drift: module docs enumerate stepup-method-tabs, stepup-method-{totp,email,sms,backup}, stepup-error, stepup-verify-btn, stepup-totp-input, stepup-backup-input — DOM exposes only 6 of them. Rendering-conditional testids (SMS/TOTP/Backup) legitimately absent, but always-visible ones (error, verify-btn) should be added.
Otp inputs inside StepUpDialog have no per-position data-testids (stepup-otp-input-{i}). Automation currently uses '[data-testid="stepup-dialog"] input' which is brittle.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 9 scenarios met; 2 minor testid gaps do not block behaviour)
